fields.description: Diamondz offers apartments in Jumeirah Lakes Towers, with leisure spaces distributed across elevated levels. Its plans distinguish conventional studios and one-bedroom homes from pool-equipped presidential and larger family layouts.

reviewCoverage.identity: Diamondz identity checked against its own project page and named plan documents; related phases are separated.
reviewCoverage.location: The sources identify Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai. No coordinates or guaranteed travel times were invented.
reviewCoverage.residences: The published Studio–4 range was checked against the named layout families; convertible spaces are not counted as extra bedrooms.
reviewCoverage.areas: Numeric plan panels were rendered and visually inspected. Apartment, balcony and total figures are kept distinct; source conflicts are disclosed below.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Project facilities were checked against the cited own page or phase-specific guide. Unit pools are limited to the layouts that show them.
reviewCoverage.pricing: The price basis and source are disclosed. Historical launch references, averages and current availability are not treated as interchangeable.
reviewCoverage.payment: Freshownhero30/70 comparedwithPF10/59/1/30post andBayut10/50/10/30post. Earlier0.5%characterization superseded byfreshvisiblehero. Stagessecondaryreferenceonly; no primarydatedschedule.
reviewCoverage.handover: Forecast dates are separated from dated construction assessments; no actual handover is inferred from a percentage or elapsed forecast.
reviewCoverage.documents: Named brochures, plans and available commercial documents were reviewed. Numeric evidence, phase distinctions and document allocations are recorded in the project artifact.

overview: The larger plans include spaces labelled office or maid room. Those rooms should be assessed by their stated use rather than counted as additional bedrooms.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Lakes Towers, Dubai. The official plan cover and project introduction identify JLT despite a separate webpage tile saying Dubai Marina. Confirm the selected unit’s access route.
research.priceNote: The developer advertises starting prices around AED 1.1 million, also retained by Property Finder as a launch reference. This does not establish an available unit, selected floor or furnishing inventory. Obtain a dated quotation.
research.paymentNote: Danube’s live hero advertises 30/70 without a complete dated calendar. Property Finder instead allocates 10% launch, 59% construction, 1% handover and 30% afterward; Bayut reports 10/50/10/30. Both secondary schedules total 100%, but their timing differs from the current headline. The displayed stages are the Property Finder reference only. No universal signed schedule was verified.
research.handoverNote: The developer estimates November 2027. Its internal inspection of 30 September 2026 reports 32% progress, with podium slabs at different levels in Wings A and B. This is a developer snapshot, not confirmation of completion or guaranteed key delivery.

facts.value: 1,219 apartments advertised; not a live inventory count.

unresolved: The 4BR upper apartment/balcony figures sum to 1,972 ft² while the printed total reaches 1,973 ft². Printed bands are retained; no approved selected-unit area is inferred.
A current dated offer, final instalment calendar, parking allocation, service charges, fit-out inventory and private-pool maintenance obligations remain unverified. Images remain illustrative.
